reviews.text: On this day, September 22, 2026, I saw Dr. Riffard. The doctor saw my Vicky, my little Chihuahua. Everything went well. The doctor gave me advice about her diet. I will do everything I can to help Vicky lose weight. I will bring Vicky back for a check-up at the end of March 2026, and I hope the goals will be met. Thank you again to Dr. Riffard for his kindness. Mrs. Lorenzi Sokange

All the staff are pleasant, welcoming, and offer helpful advice.
I recommend this clinic for its professionalism and expertise.

I was charged twice for a bag of pet food. When my mother noticed this upon returning home and checking the emailed invoice, she called to report the error. The assistant's response? Apparently, it was my mother's responsibility to realize the mistake when paying and to point it out. This blatant bad faith was used to justify a billing error that clearly wasn't our fault.

Beyond the €25 I'm owed, despite eventually receiving a credit note via email (how can you go back when they treat you like dirt, literally?), it was the attitude that ultimately convinced me to change vets. After a bill of around €400, the assistant didn't even bother to say goodbye to my mother, and the subsequent phone conversation only confirmed this impression.

So I switched clinics, and the difference is striking: the assistants and the vet are welcoming, attentive, and genuinely try to put my dog ​​at ease. They even offered to just drop by to give her some petting or treats, so she could gradually associate the clinic with something positive. All with a smile, of course.

In short, the €25 is ultimately secondary. The quality of the service and the respect shown to the client are far more important.
Always warmly welcomed by excellent, competent, and efficient professionals. Smiles and kindness towards our little animals. Thank you. The Caillet Family

A welcoming veterinary clinic that takes your concerns, your pet's history, and their needs into account. A big thank you to the receptionist who was particularly attentive to our questions and requests before we brought our animals in. She made everything (having an older cat) much less stressful; you really feel that the entire staff is caring and not just in it for the money! This wasn't my cat's original vet, but after a bad experience elsewhere, it will be!

- Following the clinic's response: you say "I immediately took your request into account," which is unfortunately false, and that's precisely what makes it unacceptable. Everything was done to ignore my request; I had to call from a blocked number, insist, and become frustrated before someone finally deigned to answer me. Indeed, the laboratory was then contacted, and you were supposed to get back to me to offer an appointment with the veterinarian, which never happened. What was offered to me were only paid solutions, which were quite unwelcome (the person on the phone told me they needed to request approval for a free follow-up appointment, an appointment I never received). - We had a very unpleasant experience at this veterinary clinic, not so much because of the error, which can happen in theory, but because of the customer service, which borders on contempt. A year ago, we had our Cavalier King Charles Spaniel chemically castrated at another clinic, and it worked very well. So, a year later, we had the prescription renewed at the same clinic for €260. During the appointment, the vet spent a long time feeling my dog, unsure if the implant was properly inserted, explaining that it was very small. A few weeks later, we realized that this time the chemical castration hadn't worked at all. We called the clinic to explain the problem: twice, I was put on hold, and after 30 minutes, no one answered. On the third call, they finally told me they would call me back without fail. Of course, no one did. When I tried again in the following days, no one bothered to answer. So I tried calling from a blocked number, and as luck would have it, they answered immediately. Seeing my frustration, they finally took the time to answer me, telling me that the vet remembered perfectly well (two months prior) that the implant had been correctly inserted. During the conversation, they tried to change the subject by suggesting I have my dog ​​neutered! Eventually, they offered me paid tests, told me they'd call me back, and of course, no one ever did. The problem isn't so much the potential for errors during the implantation itself, but rather their customer service: their refusal to address the issue by completely ignoring the client/patient and ultimately not even offering a solution, not even for the dog's well-being. From the start, I noticed (and unfortunately, many people in the neighborhood confirmed this) their sales-driven approach, the goal being to push every possible sales pitch. It's like being in a client meeting with a banker, who's just looking for a deal. The first time I came in for an emergency with a hernia; my dog ​​was in pain, but for 15 minutes, instead of relieving his pain, she spent all her time going over every vaccine I could get him in addition to the ones he'd already had. I switched doctors for the sake of proximity, but I regret it. I have no doubt they will respond to this review by trying to justify themselves, but unfortunately, my entire account reflects in detail what happened. It's a shame to treat patients this way, with contempt and ignorance, rather than with listening and kindness. It's only when there's a problem that you truly see what kind of person you're dealing with.
Easy to access. Proven skills.

I am not satisfied with my experience at this clinic. While the reception from the assistants was warm, the care my cat Venus received from Dr. Feryn was very disappointing. Since my cat wasn't a regular patient at this clinic, I clearly felt this was a problem, with a marked lack of empathy. Before I went to the emergency vet, I was asked to wait a few days for an ultrasound, which could have been fatal as my cat's condition was extremely serious. She was suffering from FIP, and the wait could have cost her her life. The prescribed medication, costing 80 euros, was completely useless. I also noticed other reviews reporting similar practices. Disappointed, I will not be returning and I currently do not recommend this veterinary clinic to anyone I know.

Thank you so much for your kind rating!

Honestly, this clinic is fantastic! Very welcoming and understanding, from the receptionists to the vets – everything is great.

Dr. Ilgard and Dr. Wurth (who takes over when she's away) have been treating my Westie for many years. They are both very competent, caring, and attentive. They always prioritize the best solution for the animal's quality of life rather than an overly interventionist approach. I've arrived several times in an emergency, and my dog ​​has always been seen promptly. The follow-up care is excellent, which is unfortunately becoming quite rare these days. The assistants are also very friendly and welcoming. I highly recommend this clinic.

On the 31st, an emergency for my little Théo, and once again you were there. Yes, even for emergencies the day before holidays or weekends, you've guided me through sometimes difficult times with excellent care, sound advice, and a listening ear. Your help has always been effective, and I can never thank you enough for helping and caring for my little ones who are so dear to me.

I simply love you all, and you are so present in your care and support.

And I wish the whole team all the best.

I will never forget. A professional, passionate, and caring team, always a warm welcome.

to the entire veterinary team, receptionists, and surgical assistants, as well as the secretarial staff and their ever-present helpfulness.

Thank you for your invaluable follow-up and advice regarding emergencies over the years, for your attentive care and guidance, and for all the surgeries, procedures, and end-of-life support.

And finally, thank you for Théa, Typpie, Tozz, Téa, Lulu, Téo, Obi-Wan, Mya, Malou and little Tyna, Vanille, Maxou, Léa, Moïse, Velours, Téo, Ange...

And lastly, thank you to Ms. Ilgard and her surgical team, as well as Ms. Bertrand and Christelle, so dear to my heart, for Théa's last surgery yesterday; she will no longer suffer from her glaucoma. A thousand thanks, I love you 💕 💗 💕 💗 💕 💗
She will always be as beautiful as Typpie and my prince Tozz.
I love you.

💝🤗🙏👌

Disappointing experience – whatever you do, don't go to her.
Initially, she quoted me a lower price, but when it came time to pay, the amount jumped to 300 euros. Her attitude was cold and condescending, as if she were doing us a favor, with financial gain as her sole priority rather than the animal's well-being.

She was rude and dismissive throughout the entire interaction. Although she promised to send the document by email, I never received it—and I don't even know if the examination was actually carried out or if she was simply in a hurry to leave.

I have already reported her on SignalConso (gouv.fr) and I intend to explore other official avenues of recourse. Having consulted numerous veterinarians over the years, this is the first time I have left a negative review—primarily due to her behavior and blatant greed.

You don't love animals—you only love money. You should be ashamed.
Excellent vet. I only take my cat there now ☺️

This clinic is a disaster. I went there after moving to the neighborhood: twice the treatments they gave made my dog ​​even worse, whereas with my previous vet the treatment was effective. When I mention it, they don't listen to me. Once is one time enough, but twice is a no-go. The vets are very unpleasant when you express your concerns. I should have sought advice before going because I mentioned it at the Henry Fabre dog park, and everyone told me not to go, that it's a money-making scheme.

My heartfelt thanks to Dr. Bertrand. She cared for my cat with infinite gentleness, rare humanity, and profound respect throughout his battle with cancer, right up to his last breath. During this heartbreaking ordeal, her presence, her words, her attentive listening, and her kindness were a true support and helped me through one of the most painful moments of my life.

Thank you also to the secretaries and reception staff for their kindness, compassion, and attentiveness, which bring so much comfort when one's heart is broken. A truly compassionate veterinarian and team, whom I wholeheartedly recommend and will never forget.

Thank you so much for these 5 stars!

I don't want to point fingers at anyone, because we're dealing with different situations: everyone has their own part to play in the fact that the appointment didn't go exactly as planned. However, three small oversights left me feeling a bit conflicted.

First, I simply wish I had been informed that the vaccine could cause slight swelling—even if it's rare, it would have allowed me to feel more at ease, especially for a Chihuahua puppy. When my partner asked for clarification, the vet didn't think it was necessary to worry us. 🫤

I also sensed a certain tension or mistrust towards me, despite mentioning that I was accompanied by a canine professional.

I think the clinic has dealt with quite a few different cases (but we're not all the same).

Finally, my credit card reached its limit after several purchases, resulting in a declined payment. Their suggestion to leave my pet as "collateral" shocked me, as I was already known to the clinic. I told them I would make the round trip, returning with a different card. Shameful to go back, everything was eventually resolved thanks to my pet.

Despite all this, I want to emphasize that the clinic remains professional and reliable. I simply hope this experience will be seen as an opportunity to further improve communication and build trust, so that future visits go as smoothly as possible.

I discovered this clinic just a few months ago, but I've had to make several visits for my cats due to some rather serious issues. So I can speak from experience and recommend it.

Regarding the prices, contrary to what I've read in some reviews, they are no higher than elsewhere. Only the emergency consultation fee is surprising, as I've never seen it charged elsewhere. Otherwise, the prices are standard and, in my opinion, justified.

For the past three years, I've regularly taken my cat to this clinic. Today, I needed an emergency appointment because I thought my pet had a contagious skin disease, which turned out to be negative. Due to my job, I unfortunately can't take time off work. I paid for an emergency consultation without being told beforehand that I would be paying double the price of a regular consultation. I'm disgusted because I wasn't informed of this at all. Furthermore, I was given an appointment, and then I was told that, given the urgency, I was squeezed in between appointments. I find there was no humanity or understanding whatsoever, only profit. I will never return to this clinic. I already found the prices high, but after what I experienced today, I no longer recommend them.

The vets are excellent and the clinic is very charming. A nice bonus is that parking is difficult in the neighborhood, and the clinic has a few parking spaces in its courtyard. I have my cat neutered and undergo routine checkups there, and everything went very well. They give good advice and take the time for each animal. The wait for an appointment is not long.

I went in today for my cat. I was well received and had a good consultation.

But unfortunately, I was surprised at reception to have to pay €249.20! For two injections, two pipettes, and a 1.5kg bag of cat food costing €27, not only was I not shown a quote beforehand, but honestly, I was so stressed about my cat's illness that I didn't ask for a quote first.
Frankly, I think the cost of treatment is outrageous. Unlike other vets, I paid double. I will never go back.

Thank you so much for your wonderful feedback!
The whole team is delighted to have been able to assist you and your companion 🐾. Your trust means so much to us 💛 and encourages us to continue providing high-quality care with gentleness and compassion.

I didn't appreciate Laveto's attitude.
If you're afraid of animals or hurting your fingers, you shouldn't be in this profession. Furthermore, she showed absolutely no empathy for the animal, making it feel safe. And then she had the nerve to tell me it would be my fault if my dog ​​wouldn't let her touch him, and if she lost her fingers—talk about a two-kilo animal, seriously? 😧 My baby lets others approach her when they reassure her. They sense everything, our little furballs. You're just awful and you don't deserve this job. In short, I'm never going back to that clinic. Even the way you speak is unpleasant. You're in this profession mainly for the money, not for the love of animals.

A very pleasant and friendly clinic, where the veterinarians and assistants are very welcoming and professional.

There are two or three parking spaces in the small garden, which is a real plus, especially in this neighborhood.

Competent and friendly.

A clinic I highly recommend. I've been going there for 24 years! And as of May 3, 2024, I can confirm that it's one of the best veterinary clinics in Marseille! Always good advice, etc. I wouldn't change it for the world.

In addition, for people who are unable to travel and have a valid reason, a vet will make a house call. That's very reassuring. Always such a friendly experience!

(Edited at the end of the message following the vet's response)
My 88-year-old grandmother has brought her 13-year-old Labrador, who is blind, could barely stand on his own, couldn't control his bladder, and was soiling himself, to the vet several times now, hoping to let him die with dignity and stop suffering. Each time, the vet told her the dog was doing very well while sending her a hefty bill of over €200-€300 every week… Saturday, April 5th, 2025, the same thing happened: my grandmother was charged another €300, and they sent her home with the dog, who could barely walk and was soiling himself, telling her he was doing great.

Today, Sunday, while visiting my grandmother, I saw the dog… I rushed to the emergency vet, who told us it wasn't possible to leave the dog like that and that we had to help him pass away with dignity, while also criticizing his colleagues at the Borely clinic who had let the dog return home in that condition every time… I won't name the vet, but I'm tempted.

Honestly, avoid this clinic. I hope my grandmother's story serves as a warning to you and saves you from wasting money. There are other very competent vets in the 13008 district.

Following the vet's response: I may have been mistaken about the exact amounts paid by my grandmother. Indeed, I don't have my nose in my grandma's wallet. I have absolutely nothing against the care you provided the dog for several years. It was another vet who saw my grandma and her dog, who didn't even examine her and wrote her a prescription on the fly, telling her, "Give him this, he'll be better. We don't put dogs down for that, he's perfectly fine." Yet, once again, my 88-year-old grandmother spent over 30 minutes trying to get the dog to stand up because he couldn't walk anymore. This vet works well at the clinic, as far as I know… There's no point in calling my grandmother to ask her to remove my comment; everything written here is the absolute truth (okay, I'll give you one point about the consultation fees, again, I don't know her financial situation). All her friends at the St-Giniez dog park saw the deplorable state in which the dog was sent home. Indeed, there have always been estimates before treatment; I don't necessarily doubt that, but rather the compassion of the person who saw my grandmother… Anyway, all the best to you.
